description: This Java class 'TwoFactorConfigurationValidator' validates JSON input for updating two-factor authentication configuration settings. It checks for required parameters, their types (boolean, string, number), and raises exceptions if validation fails.

classes.name: TwoFactorConfigurationValidator
classes.description: A Spring component responsible for validating JSON payloads for TwoFactor configuration updates, ensuring proper parameter types and presence.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the JSON input for updating two-factor authentication configuration, checks for unsupported parameters, and validates each parameter based on its expected type.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if any validation errors are collected.

methods.name: validateBooleanParameter
methods.description: Validates a boolean parameter, ensuring its value is true or false.

methods.name: validateStringParameter
methods.description: Validates a string parameter, ensuring it is not blank and does not exceed 1000 characters.

methods.name: validateNumberParameter
methods.description: Validates a number parameter, ensuring it is an integer greater than zero.
